◉　Plot

　　A dramatic history of Pu Yi, the last of the Emperors of China, from his lofty birth and brief reign in
　　the Forbidden City, the object of worship by half a billion people; through his abdication, his decline
　　and dissolute lifestyle; his exploitation by the invading Japanese, and finally to his obscure existence
　　as just another peasant worker in the People's Republic.
